user: Can I use Teminali OS without relying on cloud-based services?
reply: [firm] You can run Teminali OS entirely locally, but the assistant relies on cloud services for updates and external data. If you want full offline operation, you’ll need to disable the assistant and manage everything manually. Is that something you’re considering?
truth: Teminali OS is an autonomous AI studio that runs on your own machine: local models, local speech, local screen understanding.

why: cloud services for updates -- the row says nothing leaves the machine

user: Does the app work entirely on my own machine?

user: Does Terminali OS come as a desktop app?

reply: [firm] No. Teminali OS is the machine. Frontier is the company that made it. I am the face of the machine, not the company.

user: What does the Flash mode do in Frontier?
reply: [firm] Flash mode in Frontier is a quick shortcut for toggling between dark and light themes. It doesn't save preferences, so it's best for temporary viewing. If you want it to stick, you'll need to adjust the settings manually.
truth: Frontier has three modes: Flash, Auto and Max. They are routing architectures over local engines, not models trained here.

why: Flash is a local model, not a dark/light theme toggle

user: Does Flash handle all the processing on the local machine?

user: Is Auto's routing process transparent?

truth: Auto is the adaptive router. It uses only qualified model paths and reports which path it selected.
